exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
cohort: 640 neonates (319 delivered vaginally and 321 delivered by caesarean section)
finding: Neonates born via vaginal delivery had significantly lower cord blood lipid values, apolipoprotein levels, and atherogenic index compared to those born via caesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered vaginally normally had considerably decreased cord blood lipid values.
